summary: QXO, Inc. filed an 8-K to update its registration statement on Form S-3ASR with a prospectus supplement covering the resale of 95,876,547 common shares (including 82,809,837 issuable upon conversion of Series C Convertible Perpetual Preferred Stock) and 192,533 Preferred Stock shares by selling stockholders. The filing includes a legal opinion from Paul, Weiss, Rifkind, Wharton & Garrison LLP. This is a routine shelf takedown/registration statement update, not a special situation event like an acquisition, tender offer, or activist campaign.
